SELECT a.id AS id, a.name AS name, a.person_type AS personType, a.gender AS gender, o.office_name AS organization, p.position_name AS workShop, -- 🏭 车间字段 fpl.prod_line_name AS prodLine, -- 🏗️ 产线字段 wg.work_group_name AS teamGroup, -- 👥 班组字段 f.work_type AS workType, a.safety_helmet_id AS safetyHelmetId, a.personnel_status AS personnelStatus, a.safety_education AS safetyEducation, a.identity_card AS identityCard, a.phone_number AS phoneNumber, a.helmet_returned AS helmetReturned, a.departure_type AS departureType, a.departure_reason AS departureReason, a.departure_date AS departureDate, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_date AS createDate, a.update_by AS updateBy, a.update_date AS updateDate, a.remarks AS remarks, a.status AS status FROM swm_person a LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON f.office_code = o.office_code AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive p ON f.work_shop_code = p.id AND p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON f.work_group_id = wg.id LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line fpl ON fpl.id = wg.prod_line_id WHERE a.personnel_status = '1' and a.status = '0'
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')
AND ( p.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 🏭 车间ID查询 OR fpl.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 🏗️ 产线ID查询 OR wg.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 👥 班组ID查询 OR f.office_code = #{organizationKey} -- 🏢 厂间编码查询 )
LIMIT 50000

SELECT a.id AS id, a.name AS name, a.person_type AS personType, a.gender AS gender, o.office_name AS organization, p.position_name AS workShop, fpl.prod_line_name AS prodLine, wg.work_group_name AS teamGroup, f.work_type AS workType, a.identity_card AS identityCard FROM swm_person a LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON f.office_code = o.office_code AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive p ON f.work_shop_code = p.id AND p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON f.work_group_id = wg.id LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line fpl ON fpl.id = wg.prod_line_id WHERE a.identity_card = #{identityCard} AND a.personnel_status = '1' LIMIT 1
